description: Pinned historical toolchain. Binaries live outside the repository and are never committed or redistributed.

packer.note: Hangs under MS-DOS Player; runs headless in DOSBox-X. Sorts relocations itself.

toolchain_identity_note: Turbo Pascal 5.0 command-line compiler and standard units from the PCjs TURBO-PASCAL-500-DISK1 image (see C:/tools/borland-turbo-pascal-5.00/provenance.json). Proven by reproducing the linked System, Crt and Dos segments byte for byte in all three episodes (TP 5.5 fails the MemAvail/MaxAvail/Insert/Delete discriminants; docs/compiler.md).
